fullContent:
Sukumaram Kashayam – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Sahasrayoga, Kashayam yoga Prakarana 
 Sukumaram Kashayam (also spelled as Sukumar Kashaya) is a classical Ayurvedic medicine available in either decoction liquid form or concentrated extract tablet form. It is useful in treating various problems like menstrual pain, female health problems, and digestive problems. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Punarnava – Boerhavia diffusa 
 Bilwa – Aegle marmelos 
 Kasmari – Gmelina arborea 
 Patala – Stereospermum suaveolens 
 Syonaka – Oroxylum indicum 
 Agnimantha – Clerodendrum phlomidis 
 Prisniparni – Uraria picta 
 Shaliparni – Desmodium gangeticum 
 Kantakari – Solanum xanthocarpum 
 Bhadra – Acorus calamus 
 Gokshura – Tribulus terrestris 
 Payasya – Holostemma annulare 
 Ashwagandha – Withania somnifera 
 Eranda – Ricinus communis 
 Shatavari – Asparagus racemosus 
 Darbha – Desmostachya bipinnata 
 Kusa – Eragrostis cynosuroides 
 Sara – Saccharum spontaneum 
 Kasa – Imperata cylindrical 
 Ikshumoola – Saccharum officinarum (sugar cane root) 
 Potagala – Sphearanthus hirtus 
 Pippali – Piper longum (Long pepper) 
 Yasthimadhu – Glycyrrhiza glabra 
 Mridweeka – Vitis vinifera (Dry Grapes) 
 Yavani – Trachyspermum ammi 
 Shunthi – Zingiber officinale (Ginger) 
 
 How to Make? 
 Take equal quantity of all herbs and make fine powder and keep it overnight in water. Next day morning, heat it using water in mild fire till it reduces to 1/4th of quantity. Then filter it. 
 Dosage 
 Take 5 ml added with equal parts of water before food. 
 Indications 
 
 Severe pain during menstruation 
 Female Infertility 
 Membranous dysmenorrhea 
 Ovarian Cysts 
 Polycystic ovarian disease 
 Premenstrual syndrome (PMS) 
 Secondary amenorrhea 
 Uterine fibroids or tumors 
 Abdominal distension 
 Abdominal pain or cramps 
 Acidity or Heartburn 
 Bloating 
 Chronic Gastritis 
 Chronic Constipation 
 Duodenal ulcer 
 Gas or flatulence 
 Indigestion or Dyspepsia 
 Intestinal spasm 
 Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) 
 Peptic ulcer 
 Hepatomegaly – liver enlargement 
 Splenomegaly – Spleen enlargement 
 Hernia 
 
 Side Effects 
 There are no known side effects. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
